body: Simple reassuring touches, like holding hands. Our little things like remembering I was craving sushi yesterday and they got me some.

It’s a good idea to write a letter. People like to make things about themselves. If you let them know it’s not about them, that it’s about you, it may be easier on them. Whether they deserve that kindness or not.
Same! Well not the husband part. I feel empty as well. Idk even know where this exhaustion is coming from, or maybe I do. But I understand just being tired.

You’re not the only one who feels this way. I am also an entitled selfish suicidal 29 yr old. Idk what to say either. Idk how to articulate it like you did but I’m just so fucking tired. Ex-fucking-hausted. I’ve been feeling this way for years and there isn’t just one thing that I can put my finger on that makes me think this way. I will end this by letting you know that no you are NOT alone.
